Tractoverse — project memory

Source: AGENTS.md

Working notes for building the tractoverse R package family and its shared brand. This file holds durable, cross-task project facts only — things that are useful to a prompt regardless of the specific task. Task-specific decisions and the running to-do list live in DECISIONS.md (git-versioned, Rbuildignore’d).

The brand artifacts (final logos + _brand.yml + theme) live in inst/brand/ as the single source of truth; each package consumes them.

Package family (roles)

tractoverse is a curated family of R packages for diffusion MRI tractography, modeled on the tidyverse. The roles, as decided:

Package Role
fiber Handles data structures to host tractography data (S7: streamline, bundle, bundle_set)
master Handles simulation of streamlines/bundles/bundle sets, with possibly microstructural parameters superimposed (merges the current midi package, which handles simulation of said microstructure)
rtists Handles visualization (interactive 3D)
riot Handles data I/O (through rvtk)
toad Tractography Open Atlases Data — companion dataset package (new name for the old mascot package, renamed because “mascot” is retained for Matrix Science’s mascot software, https://www.matrixscience.com/mascot_support_v2_6.html)
bot Bundle Optimal Transport — implements statistical methods for tractography data

Signature palette (single source of truth, matches inst/brand/_brand.yml)

Package Signature color
fiber #59aaea
master #ff9441
rtists #a980fc
riot #3ec4b2
toad #ffcf1b
bot #3fb950

Each package’s logo name, tract glyph, and FontAwesome icon all use the package’s signature color. Per-package background tints and FA icons are recorded in the logo build notes in DECISIONS.md.

Working conventions

  • R is the live workspace. The running R session is the workspace; the assistant cannot see rendered images, so anything visual is validated by measurable pixel properties plus user feedback on the Positron Plots pane.
  • License: MIT (meta-package, MIT + file LICENSE). Before shipping anything that vendors/bundles third-party code (from astamm.github.io / the rtists package, or any other project), verify every vendored file’s license permits the exact use (embedding/minification/re-export) and record provenance in inst/brand/NOTICE. See also the global licensing rule in user memory.
  • Do not use any external reference image (license may be incompatible).
  • Do not edit rtists source (used as a library, not vendored).
  • RNG seeds must be a random integer in 1–10,000 (never 123/42/etc.).
  • Prefer file.exists() over dir.exists() for existence checks.
  • Filename convention: dashes, not underscores in data-raw/ scripts (e.g. compose-logo.R, crown-sample.R, build-scene.R, logo-family.R, screenshot.R). R function/object names stay snake_case (e.g. compose_logo(), crown_sample()), as do variables, fields, and .R files outside data-raw/ (e.g. package R/ files). Apply dashes broadly to future multi-word script/resource filenames unless a convention (e.g. an existing package layout) mandates underscores.

Logo pipeline

The full 6-package logo family is regenerated from scratch by a single driver: Rscript data-raw/logo-family.R (from repo root; --pkg fiber smoke-tests one). The canonical pipeline, approved art direction, and build details are recorded in DECISIONS.md under Logo family.
